nurse.text: Croeso! Welcome to the Sanctuary. Everyone here hums. Do not ask us to stop.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Pop your team on the counter. We'll have them harmonising again in a jiffy.
All better! Mind the harp, it's on loan from the Eisteddfod.
The Ark terminal's by the music stand. Do try not to put a crochet in it.

else.text: Right you are. Shout if anyone needs a plaster or a tuning fork.
